Use `make test-fast`. It runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`, which skips the Postgres-dependent tests. This matches the saved project convention.

To run everything, including the Postgres tests, use `make test`, which runs `pytest -q`. That needs a reachable Postgres.

I haven't run either target.
